findings.summary: Adopting /Users/alexraymond/ligma-classic fails reproducibly: after 'Adopt' the run sits in 'crawling' for ~2-4 minutes, then dead-ends with 'Harness malfunction — not a verdict / Env … never became healthy at http://localhost:5173'. Two consecutive attempts failed identically, so a user can never get past the crawl stage; the failure page offers no retry button — the user must navigate back home and start over.

The adoption page promises the run 'is watchable like any other run on Runs', but while the adoption crawl was actively running, the Runs page showed 'Active Sessions 0 / 3' and listed no adoption run entry anywhere — the user cannot actually watch it there.

Each failed adoption attempt still consumes Claude session quota: the Governor gauge went from 25/40 to 27/40 across the two failed runs, with only 5 sessions left before the user reserve — repeated harness faults silently burn the user's budget.

The Runs environment preflight itself flags '1 of 10 checks need attention': 'git worktree support … HEAD is detached — envs will branch off a bare commit'. This is the product's own signal that ephemeral env creation is degraded, shown while env boots were failing.

Background polling errors accumulate in the browser: repeated HTTP 405 responses on /api/dashboard and a React hydration-mismatch error is logged on page load (observed via the bridge's console and network endpoints; no visible breakage to the user).
